image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a black professional audio loudspeaker. The speaker features a rectangular enclosure with rounded corners and a protective perforated metal grille covering the front. A single large circular driver (woofer) is visible through the grille in the center, with a distinct dust cap. There is a blue logo or text graphic near the bottom edge of the grille. The background is a plain, light gray gradient.

The perforation pattern on the grille is inconsistent. Near the central driver, the holes appear to warp or change density slightly, and the reflection highlights on the mesh do not perfectly align with the underlying geometry, suggesting slight generative inconsistency in the texture mapping.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The top edge of the speaker cabinet appears slightly soft and lacks the sharp, crisp definition expected of a rigid MDF/plastic box. The corner rounding seems to blend into the background slightly more than physically plausible.
